lifecycle.basis: Derived on this read and never stored, from the composition's own declared expiry and from the runs of it that the history keeps. expired: its declared expires_at has passed, and a run of it is refused before anything runs (renew it with a later expires_at, or retire it). operating: the history keeps at least one run of it. provisioned: saved, and the history, which covers its whole life, keeps no run of it. The beat records an expiry once, on the first beat after it passes, as the service identity (expiry_recorded); a run is refused at the expiry whether or not that record has been written yet. A change to the expiry is kept in the composition's own lifecycle_events.

organism.energy_basis: 1 - 0.0s spent / 3600s stated capacity this window (the capacity is a stated assumption); the work budget is switched off (WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET), so nothing reads this figure: the energy thresholds read the ATP simulator, which cannot fall, and stay inert as ruled
organism.conserving_posture_basis: the 'conserving' posture is selected below an ATP of 0.3 and the figure cannot fall to it: consumption is at most 0.10 per tick (0.1 x a load clamped to 1.0) and production at least 0.40 (0.5 x the lowest efficiency this code passes, 0.8), so production exceeds consumption at every reachable combination and the ratio only RISES to its ceiling. It does not deplete - and NOT because of the 0.5 floor, which never binds.

work_budget.basis: 0.0s of a stated 3600s capacity is recorded spent this window, from 0 run(s) whose duration was measured — and it GATES NOTHING: the budget ships inert until WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET=true, per the Owner's ruling
work_budget.spend_basis: the sum of the run durations the platform recorded, each nest counted once (W847): a run recorded inside a marked run (a model attempt inside the AI call that made it; an AI call inside a deliverable, a composition, a swarm, a cascade tier, the board or a transformation) is held by the outermost run, which spends its own duration with the tokens its inner runs counted. A run made where the mark does not reach (a worker thread started without it) can still be counted at two levels. Durations a caller reported through /api/v1/operations/record are not counted

organism_capacity.stage_concurrency_basis: a composition's stages run one after another, and its real resources one at a time; for concurrency nothing caps or refuses that sequence (only the declared ceiling of 12 stages bounds how many resources a run attempts), and a held work budget changes nothing about it.
